instruction_bn: বাক্যগুলো সঠিক ক্রমে সাজিয়ে একটি অর্থপূর্ণ গল্প/অনুচ্ছেদ তৈরি করো (Board: rearranging, 10 marks)।

sentences: A hare was very proud of his speed.
He challenged a tortoise to a race.
The race began and the hare ran very fast.
Being confident, the hare fell asleep on the way.
The slow tortoise walked on and won the race.
items.rule_bn: গল্পের ক্রম: গর্ব → চ্যালেঞ্জ → দৌড় → ঘুম → জয়।

sentences: Honesty is a great virtue.
An honest man is respected everywhere.
People trust and love him.
He is never afraid of anybody.
So we should always be honest.
It was a rainy day.
A poor boy was going to school.
Suddenly he saw a purse on the road.
He picked it up and found some money in it.
He returned the purse to its owner honestly.
Sher-e-Bangla A. K. Fazlul Huq was a great leader.
He was born in Barisal in 1873.
He worked for the welfare of the common people.
He is called the 'Tiger of Bengal'.
He died in 1962.
items.rule_bn: জীবনী: পরিচয় → জন্ম → কাজ → উপাধি → মৃত্যু।

sentences: Once a fox fell into a well.
He could not come out of it.
A goat came there and asked about the water.
The clever fox praised the water.
The goat jumped in and the fox escaped on its back.
